_migration_info.title: ReceiptAI Google Drive to Cloudflare R2 Migration
_migration_info.objective: Replace Google Drive storage with Cloudflare R2 for commercial scalability
files_affected: n8n/v18 Dashboard - Telegram Chat ID Fix.json

nodes_to_change.reason: R2 is S3-compatible and provides free public storage
Not needed - R2 files are public by default when using public bucket

nodes_to_change.changes: Update JavaScript to generate R2 URLs instead of Google Drive URLs

upload_to_r2.name: Upload to R2
upload_to_r2.notes: Uploads receipt image to Cloudflare R2 bucket with public-read ACL

combine_ocr_and_r2_data.name: Combine OCR and R2 Data
combine_ocr_and_r2_data.notes: Generates R2 public URLs and prepares data for database INSERT

cloudflare_setup: Navigate to R2 in left sidebar
Enable 'Public Development URL' under Public Development URL section
Create API token: Settings > Manage R2 API Tokens
Save Access Key ID and Secret Access Key
n8n_setup: Add new credential: Settings > Credentials > Add Credential > AWS
Access Key ID: [Your R2 Access Key]
workflow_modification: Open 'v18 Dashboard - Telegram Chat ID Fix' workflow
REPLACE node: Delete 'Upload to Google Drive', add AWS S3 node with config above
MODIFY node: Open 'Combine OCR and Drive Data', replace code with version above
CONNECT: Build Filename → Upload to R2 → Combine OCR

optional_changes: ALTER TABLE expenses ADD COLUMN storage_provider VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'google_drive';
UPDATE expenses SET storage_provider = 'google_drive' WHERE drive_file_id IS NOT NULL;
database_impact.backward_compatibility: Old Google Drive URLs remain valid and accessible

test_steps: Verify image uploads to R2 dashboard
Copy URL from Telegram success message
Open URL in incognito browser (no authentication needed)
Verify database entry contains R2 URL
Check web application displays image correctly
success_criteria: Image accessible via public URL without login

rollback_plan.emergency_rollback: Import backup workflow to restore Google Drive version
rollback_plan.data_preservation: All R2 receipts remain accessible via stored URLs
